_readme: CHARACTER SPRITE CONTRACT. Game code never names a PNG - it asks for a logical id below. Drop a sprite sheet with the declared dimensions into this folder and it is used on the next load; no code change, no rebuild. To change a sheet's size or frame layout, edit its entry here - this is the only place geometry is defined. Missing files render as a clearly labelled placeholder sprite so the game always runs. See docs/ASSETS.md and docs/ART-BRIEF.md.

person._layout: Row 0 = facing camera, row 1 = facing right, row 2 = facing away, row 3 = expressions. Left-facing is the right-facing row mirrored automatically, so you never draw it. Columns 0-3 of rows 0-2 are the walk cycle (col 0 doubles as the standing pose); columns 4-5 are the two-frame talk loop.
person._renderScale: Sheet is cut in the legacy 320x200 space, so it is drawn at 2x on the 640x400 screen. Art authored natively at 640x400 should set renderScale to 1 and double its frameWidth/frameHeight instead.

char.jack.description: Jack Mercer, 20. Trainee arcade technician. Cheap dark jacket, band t-shirt, jeans, terrible 1987 hair. Perpetually unimpressed.

char.maggie.description: Maggie Vale, 19. Works the arcade. Practical, guarded. Denim jacket, dark red top. Never drawn as a prize - she stands like someone who knows more than you.

char.arthur.description: Arthur Bell, 57. Arcade owner. Enormous moustache, permanent mustard cardigan, shirt and tie underneath. Slightly stooped.

char.derek.description: Derek Piper, 32. TV repairman and conspiracy theorist. Brown work coat, wild hair, enormous glasses, permanently mid-explanation.

char.kevin.description: Kevin, 16. Arcade kid. Shell suit in colours that should not co-exist, pockets full of 10p pieces. Perpetually smug.

char.brenda.description: Brenda Holt, 46. Runs the kiosk. Tabard over a blouse, immovable hair, arms folded by default. Approximately 700 rules.

char.valerie.description: Valerie Price, 28. Golden Sands receptionist. Glamorous, sarcastic, entirely unimpressed by Jack. Sharp 80s shoulders, gold earrings.

char.graham.description: Graham, 34. Video shop owner. Slightly-too-tight polo shirt, moustache, the patient manner of a man who has heard every excuse.

char.drvale.description: Dr Elliot Vale. White shirt, dark trousers, black tie. Row 3 holds his three states: silhouette (18), normal (19), distorted/scanline-torn (20). His face must not be legible until frame 19 is used.

char.guest.description: Hotel guest for the Room 12 gag (s.47). Adult male in a towel and nothing else - drawn strictly from the waist up in silhouette against the bathroom light, per s.56. Comedy is the timing, not the anatomy.

char.cabin.description: Changing-cabin occupant (s.48). Adult woman, seen for a single frame before the hard cut, drawn as a flat silhouette behind a half-drawn curtain. Never rendered in detail.

char.crowd.description: Generic arcade punter, recoloured per instance. Used for the early-evening arcade crowd before closing time.
